kindNotes: hud.layer-switch: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.action-dock: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.crisis-icons: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.stuck-goods: the root has no data-frame (measured by its border and border-image)
hud.event-chips: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: the mode's tag, date, population, food, coin

hud.status-pill.sandbox.data: a new sandbox from the title: the mode's tag (the building words), date, population, food, coin, the welcome closed

hud.season-strip-panel.data: the town's year strip with its marks and the food line

hud.time-cluster.data: the speed seals (PLAY-2: the fast seal's mark ×5·10) and the settings button

hud.settings-popover.data: autoplay, tutorial, audio, save and render switches

hud.layer-switch.data: the three layers, two locked (tutorial on)

hud.action-dock.data: build, ledger, steward (undo when a site is new)

hud.steward-bubble.data: the steward's line (quiet, or the advisor's line when he speaks)

hud.crisis-icons.data: the famine's alerts (at most three bells)

hud.stuck-goods.data: the 1404 manor's worst stuck pile (a kit secondary button left of the bells)

hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.family-moment.data: the first child: the ledger's sentence, the child and the parents named, the way to the chronicle

hud.goal-help.data: a tutorial goal card's help line
hud.goal-help.unreachable: the help seal shows only on a tutorial card whose step has an advisor line; the opening card, the one after it and the chapter goal cards (tutorial off) carry none, and later steps need buildings finished (UI-AUDIT-1 smoke runs)

hud.unlock-banner.unreachable: shows only when a tutorial step unlocks a tool; no scripted path completes one (survey §2: no browser script reaches it)

hud.pause-veil.data: the paused town's badge (speed 0, no modal)

hud.completion-toast.data: the carter town's mill site finishing at speed 3

hud.era-ceremony.unreachable: shows only on the tick an era is entered; no cached state sits on that tick (survey §2: static contrast check only)

hud.zone-toolbar.data: the zone layer's kinds and tools

hud.prediction-chip.data: a living tool's placement chip over open ground

hud.hover-tooltip.data: a hungry house's cause tooltip (hover, no tool)

hud.build-drawer.fen.data: the fen's trade cards with the drain tool

hud.prediction-chip.drain.data: the drain tool's lines over a mere (cells, timber, men, seasons)
